# f5xc_policer (Resource)

* Policer objects enforces traffic rate limits<br>* network_policy_rule and fast_acl_rule can refer to a policer. Packets<br>matching those rules will be subjected to the traffic contract specified in<br>the policer

To get more information about f5xc_policer, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/policer)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Policer - Basic

resource "f5xc_policer" "example" {
  name                       = "example-policer"
  namespace                  = "default"
  description                = "Basic policer example"
  committed_information_rate = 10000
  burst_size                 = 10000
  policer_mode               = ["POLICER_MODE_NOT_SHARED"]
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Policer - Full

resource "f5xc_policer" "example" {
  name                       = "example-policer"
  namespace                  = "default"
  description                = "Full policer example"
  committed_information_rate = 10000
  burst_size                 = 10000
  policer_mode               = ["POLICER_MODE_NOT_SHARED"]

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform-team"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `burst_size` (Number) burst_size The maximum size permitted for bursts of data. e.g. 10000 pps burst
- `committed_information_rate` (Number) committed_information_rate The committed information rate is the guaranteed packets rate for traffic arriving or departing under normal conditions. e.g. 10000 pps
- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `policer_mode` (List of String) policer_mode Policer mode specifies if policer needs to share the traffic limits across term references or a seperate instance has to be created for each reference For example if Rule 1 and Rule 2 refer to policer and each rule should get bandwidth of 10Kb, then policer mode to be used is 'Not Shared' If both Rule 1 and Rule 2 cumulatively need 10kbs then a policer should be created with mode as 'Shared'<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['POLICER_MODE_NOT_SHARED', 'POLICER_MODE_SHARED']`<br>**Default:** `POLICER_MODE_NOT_SHARED`<br>**Default:** `POLICER_MODE_NOT_SHARED`
- `policer_type` (List of String) policer_type Type of a policer, for now only supported type is SingleRateTwoColor policer<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['POLICER_SINGLE_RATE_TWO_COLOR']`<br>**Default:** `POLICER_SINGLE_RATE_TWO_COLOR`
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
